intent: !has(parent.aOptionalString): absence of a field one hop across the to-one relation.

plannerDivergence.issue: has() over an omitted attribute: unknown to the planner, absent to check()
plannerDivergence.reason: Before 0.57.0 the planner folds has() to true, so the negation plans as KIND_ALWAYS_DENIED. The per-row check() calls omit parent.aOptionalString where the parent lacks it, so check() allows those rows. From 0.57.0 the plan carries the has().

trap: has() through a missing parent is an error CEL denies under both polarities, so only rows whose parent lacks the field are allowed; a flat key or an IS NULL over the joined column cannot tell a missing parent from a missing field, and its negation returns every parentless row.
